summary.screenshot_provenance: The CUA screenshots behind each help_for reading and the restoration checks were taken in the agent session that produced this file and were not saved; they are unrecoverable. The durable record is this file's per-row reading, which is an agent assertion about a screenshot no longer available. Future UI passes save each screenshot under tests/ next to the capture.

restoration.evidence: Agent-reported visual restoration check; screenshots were not persisted and are unrecoverable (see summary.screenshot_provenance). The recorded observation was that the original action and button name appeared before closing and after reopening, then Escape returned to the main window.

limitations: AX exposed only the dialog; no source-byte or token-tree readback
One screenshot per form per UI pass; runtime has repeated reads
Help labels classify visible descriptions; they do not prove parser acceptance
